S.name: Single property
S.description: One property under about 75 rooms with no dedicated IT staff

M.name: Mid size property
M.description: 75 to 200 rooms or a property with shared IT support

G.name: Group or management company
G.description: Several properties run with central IT

level_rules.note: A trigger listed on an Enhanced control makes it mandatory for profile S (A31).

triggers.T3: BMS or CCTV on the IP network
triggers.T5: Guests from a jurisdiction listed in the profile

F1.name: Governance and multi property oversight
F1.objective: Direct and oversee information security in the same way across every property under one accountable structure.

F2.name: Risk, assets and compliance
F2.objective: Know the assets, risks and legal duties of each property and measure progress against them.

F3.name: People, shifts and shared devices
F3.objective: Make every person who uses hotel systems able and accountable to work securely from the first shift.

F4.name: Identity and access
F4.objective: Tie every action on hotel systems to an identified person holding only the access the role needs.

F5.name: Configuration, vulnerability and cryptography
F5.objective: Keep hotel systems configured, patched and encrypted to a known baseline without breaking round the clock service.

F6.name: Detection, response and recovery
F6.objective: Detect, report and recover from incidents fast enough to meet legal clocks and keep guests served.

H01.name: PMS and reservations
H01.objective: Protect the PMS and reservation data as the core record of every guest stay.

H02.name: POS and payments
H02.objective: Keep card data out of hotel systems where possible and protect the cardholder data environment where it remains.

H03.name: Guest Wi-Fi and in room tech
H03.objective: Give guests connectivity and in room services without exposing hotel systems or other guests.

H04.name: Door locks and key cards
H04.objective: Keep electronic locking systems trustworthy and free of guest personal data.

H05.name: Building management and IoT
H05.objective: Bring building and engineering systems under the same security discipline as IT systems.

H06.name: CCTV
H06.objective: Operate CCTV lawfully and protect footage as personal data.

H07.name: Vendor remote access
H07.objective: Allow vendor support only through one controlled, attributable and recorded path.

H08.name: Guest data lifecycle
H08.objective: Handle guest data lawfully and minimally from booking to deletion.

H09.name: Cloud and SaaS
H09.objective: Know every cloud service holding hotel data and the security duties the hotel keeps for each.

H10.name: Third party and franchise management
H10.objective: Carry security requirements through supplier, franchise and management agreements and acquisitions.
